title: Animated Solar Irradiance Heat Maps on a Demo Table
description: Same live daylight study as the IfcOpenHouse4 sweep, on a tiny hand-built model — four legs and a tabletop, each its own SceneGeometry. A synthetic sun arcs from sunrise to sunset and the per-vertex Lambert irradiance is repainted into each part's heat-map texture every tick. Useful as a sanity check (a cube's faces have axis-aligned normals, so the lit side at zenith vs. horizon is unambiguous) and as the smallest possible test bed for the live-update pipeline.
